Overall, it was a smooth and positive learning experience. I would highly recommend Singh Motor Training School to anyone looking to learn driving with confidence and proper guidance.

featured_reviews.name: RAVINDRA PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text:
This driving school is truly excellent. I completed my training within 15 days, and Mohamad Sir and Suresh sir was assigned as my instructor. He is a very skilled trainer, supportive, and patient. He pointed out all my mistakes and helped me improve my driving skills step by step. I sincerely appreciate his guidance and support.

Initially, I was planning to join Praveen Driving Classes, but they train multiple students at the same time. I also believe they do not have a simulator machine, which is very helpful for improving judgement and confidence. However, Maruti Suzuki Driving School provides training to one student at a time, which makes a big difference in learning effectively. This personalized attention is the most important reason I chose this driving school.

Overall, it was a great learning experience, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to learn driving properly and confidently.
